paper_name: A Unified Hard/Soft Real-Time Schedulability Test for Global EDF Multiprocessor Scheduling
paper_description: Presents pseudo-polynomial tests for preemptive/non-preemptive GEDF ensuring arbitrary tardiness bounds (including zero for hard RT), unifying hard/soft analysis without utilization caps.

formal_description.statement: Job Ti,j pending at t if r_i,j <= t and not completed by t.

informal_sketch.pseudocode:
def is_pending(Ti_j, t):
    return Ti_j.r <= t and Ti_j.completed(t) == False

formal_description.statement: t_e: later of arrival t_a and time when |tau_p(t)| < m for some t < t_a.

informal_sketch.intuition: When job can start if no overload.

formal_description.statement: tau_p(t) = {Ta | some pending Ta,b at t with Ta,b <= Tk,j}.

informal_sketch.intuition: Tasks that could preempt or block.
informal_sketch.pseudocode:
def tau_p(t, tau, Tk_j):
    return [Ta for Ta in tau if any(pending(Ta_b, t) and Ta_b.deadline <= Tk_j.deadline)]

formal_description.statement: delta_k = t_d - t_0, where t_d deadline, t_0 earliest busy start.

steps: From miss time back to idle
informal_sketch.pseudocode:
def delta_k(td, t0):
    return td - t0

formal_description.statement: t_d - t_0 >= max(min(D_i), min(D_k, p_k - Theta_k)).

informal_sketch.intuition: Can't be shorter than min deadline or adjusted period.
informal_sketch.pseudocode:
def lemma1(td, t0, Di, Dk, pk, Theta_k):
    return td - t0 >= max(min(Di), min(Dk, pk - Theta_k))

formal_description.statement: If delta_k < D_k, then Tk in tau_CH (carried higher).

informal_sketch.intuition: Short interval means prior job running.

formal_description.statement: INC(Ti) <= min(DBF(Ti, delta_k), delta_k + Theta_k - e_k +1) if i!=k, min(DBF - e_k, delta_k) if i=k.
